one_line: The paper develops and applies the Water-Energy Nexus Tool (WENT) to assess energy consumption, emissions, energy recovery, and renewable integration at three municipal wastewater treatment plants; listed-sector references (steel, ammonia, hydrogen) appear only in the literature review.
